newsitem.title: USA: American Cargo sets LatAm cargo record in May.
newsitem.headline: American Cargo sets LatAm cargo record in May.

text.p: American Airlines northbound freight traffic from Latin America reached a record 28.5 million freight ton miles(FTM) in May - a 16.2 percent increase over May 1996 - the carrier reported.

Airline spokeswoman Laura Mayo said total May international freight traffic was 102 million FTMs, 4.4 percent more than it carried in May 1996. US-Europe traffic reached 57.8 million FTMs, up just 0.1 percent.
On the Pacific, the airline carried 10.7 million FTMs in May, a rise of 14.2 percent on last year, but not a record. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
